7. **Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus** - bronzing and necrotic spots
8. **Verticillium_Wilt** - wilting/drooping leaves

**Analysis:** The test image shows a macro/close-up view of a leaf with dense, velvety, gray-brown fuzzy fungal sporulation covering a large lesion area. This is the hallmark of Botrytis cinerea (Gray Mold). The KB description matches perfectly: "dense velvety gray-brown spore mass on infected tissue" and "fluffy gray spores cover infected plant parts." No other candidate disease produces this type of thick, velvety gray-brown sporulation on leaf tissue. While the Gray_Mold reference was a wider shot, it showed the same tan-brown necrotic tissue characteristic of the disease. All other candidates were visually very different.
